details.publicNotes:
Gasping deaths are air elementals corrupted by the touch of the void. Gasping deaths exist at the boundary between life and death, and are instinctively drawn to gain a greater understanding of this boundary. As a result, they often seek out living creatures to suffocate, so they can observe their final moments and then play around with their corpses. They are particularly likely to attack creatures of a type they haven't seen before, in hopes of gaining a new perspective.

Companions in Blasphemy

Gasping deaths are sometimes found as companions to necromancers, who earn the elemental's cooperation by sharing their knowledge. In exchange, the necromancer typically asks the gasping death to perform various tasks or serve as a bodyguard.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 45/100/180 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (slashing), armor (light), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Nature, Religion, Stealth)

Eligible Imbued Properties air, bane, death, dexterity, energy resistant (vitality, void), sensory (darkvision), unholy, wild, winged, wisdom

description.value:
Trigger The gasping death is targeted by an attack from a creature it can see

Requirements The gasping death is in a creature's lungs

Effect The gasping death retreats into the creature's lungs, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC. If the attack critically misses, it hits that creature instead.

Requirements The gasping death is currently in a creature's lungs

Effect The gasping death attempts to suffocate the creature. The creature loses remaining rounds of air using the suffocation rules and takes void damage based on the results of a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The creature prevents the gasping death from entering its lungs.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d4[void]] damage and loses 1 round of remaining air.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d4[void]] damage and loses 2 rounds of remaining air.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d4[void]] damage and loses all of its remaining air.

Requirements The gasping death is occupying the same space as another creature of size Huge or smaller that can breathe, and it is not currently in a creature's lungs

Effect The gasping death surrounds the creature's face and attempts to enter its airways. The creature attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d4[void]] damage before expelling the gasping death.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d4[void]] damage as a portion of the gasping death enters its lungs. The creature must immediately begin holding its breath.

Critical Failure As failure, and the gasping death can use Choke once as a free action.

While the gasping death is in a creature's lungs, it can't move from that creature's space, but it automatically moves with the creature. The gasping death can leave a creature's lungs as a free action.

A creature that begins its turn with the gasping death in its lungs can spend 1 action to attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save to cough it up. On a success, they expel the gasping death from their lungs, taking @Damage[2d6[slashing]] damage and @Damage[1d8[void]] damage as the elemental rakes at their lungs. On a critical success, they expel the gasping death without taking additional damage.
The gasping death's form is mostly insubstantial. It can enter and occupy the same space as other creatures, and it can move through a gap at least 1 inch wide without Squeezing.
The gasping death's movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Requirements A creature with the gasping death in its lungs has died in the last round

Effect The gasping death puppets the creature as an undead shell. The gasping death can use its actions to force the creature's body to perform any of the actions it could have taken in life. If the gasping death takes @Damage[20[untyped]] damage, it is forcibly released from the creature's body.
